title_lines: BANAUE, PHILIPPINES 🌾⛰️ For two thousand years the terraces
have climbed this mountain — every stone wall traces one height.
Find where the village walks without climbing. 🎧
question: Where can the farmers walk a level path THROUGH the village — the center's note carried out to both sides? 🌾
hint_lines: A level path sings ONE note — listen for the middle note
stretched sideways by an arc of friends, uphill voices above it,

options.label: A
options.explain: That was the SUMMIT — its height belongs to one single point, so there is no room to walk level there. The paths live on the slopes. 🙂

options.label: C
options.explain: The whole land was ONE height — a floor, not a mountainside. Terraces are carved where the land slopes. 🙂

options.label: D
options.explain: That was the bottom of a PIT — lovely level rings around you, but the lowest note itself belongs to a single point, just like a summit. 🙂

success_text: A LEVEL PATH! 🌾 The middle note stretched along a curve — walk it and the music never changes. That curve is a CONTOUR, and the terraces you see are contours made of stone. 🎉
